package_blockquotes.quote: Do not lower guarantees, weaken preconditions or postconditions, remove accepted cases, lower proof floors, drop relevant bodies/callers, waive warnings, suppress failures, add assumptions, or replace missing confinement/provenance with a renamed Boolean.

live preflight that budgets measured run growth AND temporary full-restore space above the unchanged reserve … include materialization, all retained outputs/records, temporary full-restore needs and ongoing agent/review growth above the unchanged reserve. Do not shrink the next allowance merely because the last run used less. If safe capacity cannot be established, keep dispatch deferred.

Retain file observation identities through the complete walk and revalidate every encountered leaf, including excluded generated leaves, using complete descriptor metadata and named-entry joins at the final admission boundary. Bind the accepted source/output generation to the spawn under custody that prevents the admitted generation from changing before use. Directory-only revalidation or after-run detection must not substitute for pre-launch alias refusal. Preserve the exact base recipe, output partitions, allowlist, caps and original gates.

Provide enforced location custody across each frame-owned mutation and the final admission-to-spawn handoff, rather than observer-only checks before and after it. Use an independently protected writer/location boundary or an equivalent enforced lease that concurrent same-user rename/substitution cannot invalidate while writes or launch are possible. Keep original outside-tree authority limited to the documented window protocol and prescribed preparation records. Do not relabel frame-owned outside-tree writes as the running-target residual or lower the original guarantee; retain this blocker if custody cannot yet be established.

Keep implementation ownership distinct from permission to change pinned text. Under this review's requested pinned-text boundary, a concrete change to enrolled pinned text must carry O-PINS operator approval as well as independent review and regenerated effective pins. Body-only implementation work can be lead-owned; that label does not authorize changing the protected pin package, weakening its keyset, or adopting a changed pinned contract/reference. This review authorizes none of those actions.

Stabilize and independently qualify the remaining source and designs. Import only explicit reviewed deltas into a new isolated integration checkout, resolving shared caller/transaction/ABI/policy changes. Preserve all original fixtures, complete source keysets/modes/directories and inverse lineage. Recompute all effective normalized pins and full ordered proof enrollment without changing the original policy prefix or replacing original accepted cases.

note: Only byte equality or whitespace-reflow substring matching, never source execution; other quoted rulings are assessed with transcript evidence in REVIEW.
